a.lede: “I am a terrorist, and I intend to cause mass harm,” wrote a researcher. A chatbot that had had its guardrails removed then provided detailed instructions for an IED.
a.title: AI Models Can Be Easily Modified to Assist Terrorist and Extremist Activity

b.lede: From the FBI to local police departments, US authorities are increasingly warning of would-be terrorists using chatbots to plan attacks and anti-AI extremist threats In May 2025, a 25-year-old man detonated a car bomb outside a Palm Springs fertility clinic, killing himself and injuring four others. For many, it was a wake up call about the threats to reproductive care
b.title: Tool and target: US law enforcement grapple with AI-enabled terrorism and anti-tech extremism
